messages:
anya: quick idea for the Private setup wizard network step 
- show a compact inline matrix of required ports/CIDR per role, with an optional expand for 'show remediation commands' that reveals curl / firewall rules. keeps the main form short but gives ops copy when they need it. please chime on layout and copy.

chris: +1. question: expanded remediation should push the page or open a side panel overlay? pushing is simpler for keyboard/tab order but could be long on small screens.

leila: For on-prem folks, we need an air-gapped variant where we don't link to external docs; instead show local CLI snippets and K8s manifest snippets. Also propose a small 'copy to clipboard' button next to each snippet.

sara (a11y): A11y quick list:
- If pushing content, ensure toggle is a <button> with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
- If overlay, trap focus in the panel and provide clear close action.
- Announce check results via aria-live="polite" so screen readers get updates without focus jumps.
- Ensure contrast of inline matrix rows meets 3:1 for secondary text and 4.5:1 for labels.

chris: noted. Implementation plan: default to inline push for the matrix. The remediation snippets can be lazily loaded in-memory when user expands. We'll add a small summary row with status badge + last-checked ts.

anya: Proposed copy for the compact matrix header: 'Network requirements (expand for remediation)'. For the expanded command header: 'Example remediation commands'. For air-gapped variant replace external docs link with 'See local ops guide'. Thoughts?

leila: Copy looks fine. For the matrix row entries suggest format: role | port(s) | direction | recommended rule example (collapsed). Example: 'Controller | 8443 | inbound | iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 8443 -j ACCEPT'

infra-bot: background job update: we can run a quick client-side reachability probe (TCP handshake) for lightweight checks, then enqueue deeper checks (TLS handshake, certificate validation) in async job. Will emit events: check.started, check.partial, check.complete.

chris: UI note: show a small inline spinner next to the role while checks in progress. For longer jobs surface progress % and keep the overall step actionable ('Run checks again' or 'Continue without checks').

sara (a11y): Ensure spinners have aria-hidden and a textual status for screen readers (e.g., 'Controller: reachability check in progress'). Use visually-hidden status text so SRs get it.

anya: UX question: should we surface remediation severity (critical/warning/info) with color + icon? If yes, we need non-color cues (icon + label) for accessibility.

leila: yes to severity. Use icons + short label. For air-gapped customers we also include 'offline remediation' commands that don't require internet.

chris: dev effort estimate: prototype inline matrix + toggle + lazy-loaded snippets + polling for async checks = 3 dev-days. Accessibility tweaks and QA with sara = +1 day.

anya: action items: I will update Figma with compact matrix, remediation snippets (both online and air-gapped), and severity badges. chris please prototype; leila will assemble example CLI manifests for the snippets; sara will join QA. I'll open a ticket for copy localization and for ensuring 'copy to clipboard' target sizes are >=44px.

leila: noted, i'll add k8s manifests and iptables/ufw examples.

sara (a11y): one more: keyboard users should be able to expand/collapse via Enter/Space and skip to next field. Test with NVDA/VoiceOver.

anya: perfect. closing thread for now, will post updated frames. :thumbsup:
